review_scope: Only exact host, installer, manifest, discovery and instruction-carrier cases are translated. No SEO analysis, fetcher, parser, schema, quota or account-data invariant is waived. Source cases remain on disk.

cases.reason: Codex does not enforce Claude tools: frontmatter grants. The specialist task keeps the sanctioned connected-MCP-only route, denies credential-store inspection and raw-HTTP/shell bypass, and fails closed when tools are absent.

The source mirror invariant is retained unchanged. Codex notices now use a common resolved-root reference and both DataForSEO prompts receive identical credential guidance, restoring byte-identical domain content.
Claude JSON-merge source snippets are replaced by a Codex TOML connection emitter. The dataforseo server identity and pinned MCP tool contract are still enforced.
